typography.instructions: Use 'Onest' for all UI elements, headings, and labels. Use 'JetBrains Mono' exclusively for the 3-digit personnel codes, dates, and time/sync indicators. DO NOT use Inter or Roboto.

colors.instructions: Maintain high contrast. Backgrounds should be cold tinted greys (slate), never pure black (#000000). Use the cyan/fuchsia gradient creatively but sparingly: for the active tab indicator, top header border, or hover states on pills. It must remain a highly readable operational tool.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 for sticky headers, popovers, and dropdowns. Ensure a 1px inner stroke border-slate-700/50 to define the edges.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-slate-800) to separate zones in tables and define container edges. Avoid heavy box-shadows on dark mode, rely on borders.
visual_enhancers.pills: Personnel numbers must be distinct pills. Use rounded-md, monospace font, inline-flex, items-center, justify-center, w-14 h-8. Default state: bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700. Hover state: border-cyan-500 text-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)].

layouts.desktop: A wide 3-column grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6) to show Today, Tomorrow, and Day-after-tomorrow side-by-side simultaneously. This is critical for the operational view.
layouts.mobile: Tabbed layout using Shadcn Tabs. Show only one day at a time to prevent horizontal scrolling.
layouts.table_structure: Inside each day column, list the Zones vertically. Each Zone row should have a left section (Zone Code & Description, e.g., 'A1 - Spinale') and a right section (flex-wrap container of personnel pills assigned to that zone).
layouts.header: Sticky top header containing: Logo/Title, Search Bar (name/number), Dropdown Filter (Zones A, B, Z, Assenti), and Live Sync Indicator.

components.personnel_pill: Clickable button showing a 3-digit number. Font: JetBrains Mono. Triggers the Popover. MUST have data-testid='personnel-pill-{number}'.
components.popover: Shadcn Popover. Shows the person's full name, and a mini-list of all other zones/days they are assigned to. Glassmorphism background. MUST have data-testid='personnel-popover'.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for mobile day switching. The active tab indicator should utilize the cyan-to-fuchsia gradient.
components.search_bar: Shadcn Input wrapped in relative container with a search icon (lucide-react). MUST have data-testid='search-input'.
components.zone_filter: Shadcn Select for filtering zones. MUST have data-testid='zone-filter'.
components.sync_indicator: A small pulsing dot (animate-pulse) next to text 'Ultimo agg: HH:MM'. MUST have data-testid='sync-indicator'.

motion.hover: Personnel pills scale up slightly (hover:-translate-y-0.5) and their border glows cyan.
motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-out for all interactive elements.
motion.popover: Popover content should use Framer Motion for a subtle scale-in (0.95 to 1) and fade-in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards against the dark slate background.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
accessibility.focus: All buttons and inputs must have focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-950.

image_urls.usage_instructions: Optional: Use as a very faint, highly blurred background (opacity-5 to opacity-10) for the main app background to subtly hint at the Alpine context without distracting from the dense data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: Add '<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Onest:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">' to index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js to include font families: sans: ['Onest', 'sans-serif'], mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'].
Use Shadcn UI components for Tabs, Popover, Select, Input, and Badge.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background for the Popover or Select dropdowns. They MUST use bg-slate-900/90 with backdrop-blur-xl.

Create robust mock data: generate ~15 personnel with 3-digit IDs, mapping them to assignments across 'Today', 'Tomorrow', 'Day After'. Populate Zones A (Spinale-Groste), B (5 Laghi-Pradalago), Z (Varie), and Assenti.
Ensure the Desktop layout shows the 3 days simultaneously in a grid-cols-3 layout. Use Tabs only on mobile (lg:hidden).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform styling. Use asymmetry and generous spacing where appropriate.
NEVER use pure black #000000. Use slate-950 for backgrounds.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not apply global transitions (e.g., transition: all in CSS). Target specific properties.
Ensure high contrast and readability. This is an operational tool, so function comes first, but the aesthetics should be highly polished and modern.
Implement a realistic 'Live Sync' indicator at the top that shows the last updated time and pulses to indicate active status.
